description.value: Hoang Gia is a Vietnamese restaurant in Kelowna near Costco on Highway 97 N, specializing in pho, sushi, and noodles. The restaurant distinguishes itself by using Brant Lake Wagyu Beef — naturally raised, hormone-free Alberta beef — in all beef dishes. Online reservations are available and the dining room is described as having a distinct atmosphere.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website for hoanggia.ca loaded successfully and confirms an active Vietnamese restaurant at 2469 Highway 97 N, Kelowna, with phone +1-250-861-3010. The OSM name 'hoang gai' is a misspelling — the business consistently identifies itself as 'Hoang Gia' across all website pages. No website content mentions bike parking, water refill, washrooms, takeout, or any cycling-relevant amenities, so those are all null.
